purpose_context: The programme has shipped seven adapters and a growing set of rubrics but no single place documents how to run every suite locally, what each rubric normatively cites, or which known gaps were knowingly left open and why. This mission is the programme terminus: it writes down what exists so the next mission can find it, without adding new checks or changing rubric content.
purpose_tldr: Operator guide, rubric index, and evidence-linked recorded-gaps register for the muster conformance programme.
